editorial:
Imagine a guy who is basically a professional liar and a total mama's boy. He spends his days selling terrible, low-quality alcohol to bars, but he has a secret trick to make it work. Instead of being a salesman, he acts like a huge crybaby and tells fake, sad stories about his life to make people feel bad for him. It is a weird and funny setup that makes you wonder how he gets away with it. Then, things get even crazier when he meets a gorgeous woman who has a very strange goal. While most people want a thrilling partner, she specifically hunts for the most boring, unexciting men on the planet. The vibe is lighthearted and quirky, focusing more on the funny dialogue and the weird chemistry between two people who are both a bit broken in their own ways.

You will really love how the acting makes these odd characters feel real. The pacing is snappy, and the jokes land well because they don't try too hard to be funny. While the plot is simple, the way the characters clash is where the magic happens. If you enjoy old-school comedies with a bit of a bite, you should definitely check this out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: In the end, the main character's lies finally catch up with him, but it actually helps him win over the woman. She finds his pathetic nature and his habit of crying exactly what she is looking for in a partner. Instead of being disgusted by his fake sadness, she is attracted to it. They end up together because they both fit into each other's weird needs, proving that being a jerk can actually work if you find the right person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves odd couple comedies and witty dialogue.
